tools.name: list_states
tools.description: List the U.S. states that have a septic licensing page and/or a septic company directory page on thesepticguide.com, with links.

tools.name: get_state_licensing
tools.description: Who licenses septic installers/pumpers in a U.S. state, the agency's official license lookup link, and the licensing Q&A published on thesepticguide.com.

tools.name: search_septic_companies
tools.description: Search the septic companies thesepticguide.com lists in a state, optionally filtered by city, county, ZIP, service or license match. Returns each listing's state license record(s) with the agency verify link, phone and website as published.

tools.name: get_cost_guide
tools.description: Septic cost guidance (pumping, inspection, repair, installation, drain field, tank replacement, aerobic systems) as published on thesepticguide.com: the short answer, cost tables, and the third-party sources the page cites. Call with no topic to list topics.
